name: Derghodemon
tactics: Employed as shock troops in abyssal armies, derghodemons are adept at burrowing beneath—and smashing through—enemy fortifications. A derghodemon barrels across the battlefield, moving to the center of an enemy formation to rend and tear foes using its claws. A derghodemon is near-suicidal in its aggression. Even when vastly outnumbered, a derghodemon fights to the death.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.details: Enemies can’t gain combat advantage by flanking the derghodemon.

effect.description: The derghodemon uses claw four times, no more than twice against a single target. If a single target is hit with claw twice, the derghodemon grabs the target.

The derghodemon moves its burrow speed below the surface of the ground, avoiding opportunity attacks as it passes underneath other creatures’ spaces. As it burrows beneath the space of a Large or smaller creature on the ground, the derghodemon makes the following attack against that creature.

powers.name: Death Hook
powers.requirements: The derghodemon must not have a creature restrained.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature grabbed by the derghodemon

hit.description: damage, and the target enters the derghodemon’s space, is restrained, and takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends all). If the derghodemon moves, the restrained creature moves with it.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The derghodemon takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The derghodemon gains resist 15 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.
